name: Level 24: Quad-Robot Distributed Parallel Sum
description: 4-Robot Distributed Computing Network! Robot 0 reads [10, 20, 30, 40] from Inbox (0,1) and distributes pair halves over IPC to Robot 1 and Robot 2. Robot 1 and Robot 2 sum their pairs and send to Robot 3. Robot 3 calculates the grand total (100) and drops it in Outbox (8,1)!
